data.one_liner: A Dart library for RFC8949‑compliant CBOR encoding and decoding.
data.what_it_does: It provides APIs to encode Dart objects to CBOR binary format and decode CBOR data back to Dart objects. Supports indefinite length, streaming, and advanced types like rational numbers.
use_when: You need compact binary serialization for IoT or low‑bandwidth communication
You require CBOR support with streaming or custom tag handling
avoid_when: You prefer a code‑generated model layer
strengths: Streaming support and indefinite length handling
Rich type system with tags and rational numbers
weaknesses: Limited to CBOR – not a general-purpose serializer
